// diagnostic

E1108

A list method (e.g. `.map`, `.filter`, `.sort`, `.pop`, `.remove`, `.get`) was called on a `#Layout(columnar)` list.

What

A list method (e.g. `.map`, `.filter`, `.sort`, `.pop`, `.remove`, `.get`) was called on a `#Layout(columnar)` list.

Why

v1 columnar lists support the core surface — indexing, field access, `len`, `is_empty`, `push`, and iteration; the rest is deferred rather than silently miscompiled.

Fix

Drop `#Layout(columnar)` from the struct to use the full list API, or rewrite the operation with indexing and a loop.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1108: tests/ui/layout_columnar_unsupported_method.stderr.

Error [E1108]: writing through `[ ]` isn't supported on a columnar list `[Particle]` yet
  --> tests/ui/layout_columnar_unsupported_method.jet:9:7
    |
  9 |     ps[0] = Particle{x: 2.0, y: 3.0}
    |       ^^^
 Why: `#Layout(columnar)` lists support reading in v1 (indexing, field access, `len`, `is_empty`, `push`, iteration); index-write is deferred
 Fix: drop `#Layout(columnar)` from `Particle` to assign through `[ ]`, or rebuild the list with `push`
